browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; touch buttons were pointer events on the real touch buttons; Start, language, room tiles and Play again were real mouse clicks. Only visible DOM text and canvas pixels were read; no game state was read or injected.
phoneLayouts: Checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page.
servedSourceCheck: The SHA-256 of the served src/games/mirror-lab.js and src/games/mirror-lab-rooms.js were computed in the page and matched f3999576 and 2f581968.

observed: A driver that reads only the status-line prompt, with a 0.25 s reaction delay and pressing each named arrow exactly the stated number of times, played rooms 1 to 22 in Chinese back to back in under 4 minutes and reached '完成得漂亮！全部房间通关，实验台归你了！' with the maximum score of 2200, so every room was solved in its optimal number of turns.
English room select listed all 22 rooms after the win.

English: on budget room 13 (7 turns) a wrong turn immediately changed the prompt to 'Too few moves left: press Z to undo'; spending all 7 turns ended the run with 'Out of turns in room 13. Try it again.'; arrows, Space, Z and Q on the loss screen changed nothing. Play again returned to room select.

English phone frame, 371 px wide with no horizontal overflow: the touch arrows and Turn button selected room 1, and touch taps alone following the prompt cleared rooms 1 to 3. On room 4 the Undo touch button reverted a turn (Turns 1 to 0) and Reset restored the room.

limitations: Physical phones, other browsers, tapping cells on the canvas, the shutter key by hand and audio were not tested; console output was not captured.
